name: io.github.CarbonDataSolutions/carbon
title: Carbon
description: Hire skills-assessed data professionals from any MCP host. Post your role free.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the connected carbon.talent hiring account (name, email, company, verification).

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List your company's roles with status, location, and applicant counts.

tools.name: get_role
tools.description: Get one of your roles in full, including applicants by stage.

tools.name: create_role_draft
tools.description: Create a private role draft for your company. Asks you to confirm first in most hosts.

tools.name: post_role
tools.description: Submit a draft role for publishing. Asks you to confirm first in most hosts.

tools.name: list_applicants
tools.description: List applicants for one of your roles with stage and applied time.

tools.name: get_applicant_summary
tools.description: Summarise one applicant without contact details, CV, rates, or scores.

tools.name: move_applicant_stage
tools.description: Moves an applicant on one of your roles to Applied, Screened, Interview, or Offer. The applicant gets the same update the portal sends. Mark someone Hired in the carbon.talent portal. Asks you to confirm first in most hosts.

tools.name: search_talent
tools.description: Search the talent catalog by skills, experience, location, or keywords (first name plus last initial).

tools.name: get_talent_profile
tools.description: Get one talent catalog profile by the id returned from search.
